description: Abstract class defining a base form for the Drupal Migrate Upgrade UI, handling form building, redirection, and configuration dependencies.

classes.name: MigrateUpgradeFormBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for the Drupal Migrate Upgrade form, providing common functionality and dependencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting configuration, migration plugin manager, state, and tempstore services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form array, setting up actions and submit button, and determines the destination site version.

methods.name: restartUpgradeForm
methods.description: Redirects to the overview step and sets the form step in temporary storage.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Abstract method to get the confirmation button text.
